chunks: Allah, Blessed and Exalted, said to His Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله:
"And during the night, perform Tahajjud with it as an extra for you; perhaps your Lord will raise you to a praised station."

Thus, the night prayer became obligatory upon the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله because of the saying of Allah, Mighty and Majestic, 'فَتَهَجَّدْ'; while for others it is a sunnah (prophetic tradition) and a supererogatory act.

key_terms.سُنَّةٌ: A prophetic practice that is recommended rather than obligatory.
key_terms.صَلَاةُ اللَّيْلِ: The night prayer performed during the night.
key_terms.مَقَامًا مَحْمُودًا: A praised station granted by Allah.
key_terms.نَافِلَةً: An additional devotional act beyond what is obligatory.

ai.seo_question: Was the night prayer obligatory for the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله and voluntary for others?
ai.summary: This passage cites the Quranic command of night vigil prayer addressed specifically to the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله. It explains that salat al-layl was obligatory for him by virtue of this command, while for others it remains a sunnah (prophetic tradition) and a voluntary act.
